profile.headline: SWE Intern @ State Farm | Georgia Institute of Technology | Accounting + Computer Science Student
profile.summary:
I am a dual major in Computer Science and Accounting at the Georgia Institute of Technology, where I focus on how technical systems shape real business operations. My academic background combines software engineering, data systems, and financial processes. This training has given me a structured way to evaluate problems, build reliable tools, and understand how data flows through organizations. This shows in my interest in AI, cybersecurity, data analytics, accounting workflows, data entry processes, and property and casualty modeling.

My professional experience includes software engineering, site reliability, and operations roles across large companies, startups, and campus teams. I have built production systems, automated workflows, and data pipelines that improved speed and accuracy. This shows how I work between engineering and business teams to turn operational needs into scalable solutions. I take a calm, detail focused approach and prioritize practical impact.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: I work as an Office Assistant at the Georgia Institute of Technology, where I support daily administrative operations by managing schedules, coordinating office tasks, and assisting staff with routine requests. My role requires strong organization, clear communication, and attention to detail in a fast-paced academic environment.

positions.title: Athletic Trainer
positions.description: I work as an Athletic Trainer at the Georgia Institute of Technology, where I assist with athlete care during practices and events by supporting injury prevention, treatment, and recovery activities. This role involves close collaboration with trainers and athletes, working under time pressure, and maintaining a high standard of safety and professionalism.

positions.title: Compiler Developer
positions.description: I work as a Compiler Developer and Team Coordinator with Big Data Big Impact at Georgia Tech, where I contribute to compiler-related development tasks and help coordinate a student technical team. During my time on the team, I have supported code development and testing while helping organize team efforts to meet project goals and deadlines.

company.name: Big Data Big Impact @ Georgia Tech

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked as a Software Engineer Intern at Baraka (Y Combinator ’21), where I contributed to backend infrastructure, search optimization, and data engineering initiatives. During my time there, I helped enhance search performance, build core API features, and improve data processing pipelines that supported the company’s financial product ecosystem

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked as a Site Reliability Engineer Intern at McDonald’s Corporation in Atlanta, where I helped keep production systems stable, automated deployment processes, improved monitoring and alerting, and supported the migration of legacy services to the cloud. My work contributed to higher uptime, faster deployments, and more efficient incident response across critical infrastructure.

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration - BSBA
